title: Choc Pie

steps.text: Melt the chocolate and butter in a double boiler.
Mix the flour, sugar and salt together and stir into the chocolate.
Add the scalded milk and stir constantly until the mixture thickens, about 15 minutes.
Beat the egg yolks well; stir in a little of the chocolate mixture, then pour into the rest of the hot mixture.
Remove from heat, cool, and add the vanilla.
Pour into a baked pie shell and chill.

notes: Signed "All my love, Alice". The baked pie shell and whipped cream appear only in the method.
